articles.title: Robinhood sees surge in bitcoin, gold prediction markets as traders move beyond sports
articles.snippet: The company's head of futures and prediction markets said bitcoin, gold and oil contracts are among its fastest-growing prediction markets.

articles.title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam test after security devs flag risk to existing contracts
articles.snippet: Developers canceled Monday's Hoodi activation after researchers showed how new gas rules could let smart contracts permanently record failed operations.

articles.title: ECB official sees digital euro as key to protecting EU ‘sovereignty’
articles.snippet: Piero Cipollone said the bloc is on track to test real transactions in 2027 and roll out a digital euro as early as 2029, pending legislation this year.

articles.title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam Hoodi testnet launch over security risks
articles.snippet: ChainSecurity said it identified 13 real-world examples of smart contracts potentially affected by Glamsterdam’s gas changes and is coordinating responsible disclosure with affected projects.

articles.title: Ethereum Delays Glamsterdam Testnet Fork Over Gas Security Flaws
articles.snippet: The Hoodi testnet fork is off after ChainSecurity found gas changes that could let contracts lock in failures, citing 13 real-world cases.
